<p class="eyebrow">Teaching</p>

# Connecting economic reasoning to real estate decisions.

At Cal State Fullerton, I teach courses in real estate principles and investment analysis, with an emphasis on applied market evidence, financial modeling, and professional practice.

::: {.course-grid}
::: {.course-card}
<span class="course-code">FIN 351</span>

## Real Estate Principles

An introduction to property rights, markets, finance, valuation, brokerage, and the institutions that shape real estate decisions.
:::

::: {.course-card}
<span class="course-code">FIN 355</span>

## Real Estate Investment Analysis

Applied analysis of property cash flows, financing, risk, valuation, and investment decisions using spreadsheet models and case-based work.
:::
:::
